## About Ashley
* ### Ashley Furniture
  
  Shopping for new furniture and decor takes plenty of time and effort. We’re here to simplify your
  home makeover journey. You can find everything you need and more with just one stop at Ashley.
  Want to learn more about Ashley Furniture? Here’s a glimpse into how you can transform your home
  and save big!
* ### About Ashley Furniture
  
  At Ashley Furniture, we believe your home should be an extension of you. Our expansive collection
  of furniture and decor has something special for everyone. No matter your style or budget, we
  ensure you’ll find pieces that speak to you and reflect your personality. From standout pieces to
  timeless finds, we strive to help you create the ideal space to share unforgettable memories with
  your loved ones.
* ### What Products Does Ashley Sell?
  
  Whether you’re searching for the top mattress brands or giving your patio a much-needed update,
  you’ll discover incredible finds at Ashley Furniture. As the #1 furniture home store in North
  America, we have everything you need to complete your home’s aesthetic. Find unmatchable pieces
  and unbelievable deals on:
  * [ Living Room Furniture ][74]: Make your living area the ideal comfort zone with exclusive
    sofas, loveseats, sectionals, recliners, ottomans, and more.
  * [ Rugs ][75]: Explore rugs, pads, and accessories for any room at Ashley HomeStore. Shop rugs by
    size to ensure the perfect fit for your space.
  * [ Storage Solutions ][76]: Dealing with a small space? Our closet systems, clothing racks,
    shelving accessories, and more can make organization effortless.
  * [ Bedroom Furniture ][77]: Revamp your bedroom with our signature bedroom collections, dressers,
    nightstands, and makeup vanities.
  * [ Kids & Baby Furniture ][78]: Find everything for your child’s bedroom, as well as baby
    strollers, bathtubs, and play mats.
  * [ Kitchen & Dining Furniture ][79]: Create an inviting atmosphere in your kitchen and dining
    area with top-quality dining room sets, bar furniture, storage, and more.
  * [ Home Office Furniture ][80]: We’ll help you design an office space you’ll actually want to
    work in with our signature home office collections, desks, bookcases, and office chairs.
  * [ Mattresses ][81]: Ashley Furniture is home to top mattress brands, including Stearns & Foster,
    Sealy, Purple, and Tempur-Pedic. Complete your sleeping sanctuary with pillows, bedding,
    mattress foundations, adjustable bed bases, and more.
  * [ Outdoor Furniture ][82]: Deck out your patio with the hottest finds in outdoor lounge, dining,
    and bar furniture and accessories. We even have fire pits!
  * [ Decor ][83]: No home is complete without fabulous decor. Our extensive selection of home
    decorations, such as wall art, sculptures, home accents, and lighting, will delight your inner
    interior designer.
* ### Find an Ashley Store Nearest You
  
  Ready to revamp your space? Shop us online or visit us in-store to get started. We’re located
  nationwide, with over 1,000 Ashley stores across the globe! Find your neighborhood Ashley
  Furniture by searching “Ashley Furniture near me” on Google or visit our [ store locator here
  ][84]. Countless incredible finds await you!

**About Us**

With a foresighted vision to carve your dream Furniture into reality as per latest trends, we, **Sri
Anu Furnitures And Furnishing**, established ourselves back in **1994**. Since then, we have been an
accredited** manufacturer and wholesaler** of **Mirrored Dressing Table, Modern Dressing Table,
Restaurant Luxury Banquet Chair, Auditorium Chair, Solid Wood Canteen Dining Table, Pneumatic
Revolving Stool, Classroom Furniture and more**. All these are designed and carved to perfection by
our team of skilled and highly proficient craftsmen, designers, carpenters and other personnel. We
also have a widespread infrastructural facility at **Hyderabad (India)** and showrooms across 4
cities like **Chandanagar, Miyapur, Habsiguda and LB Nagar**. These cover an overall area of** 1
lakh 60 thousand sq. ft**.

Having gained a reputed hold in the industry with immense goodwill amongst the clients has been a
result of **impeccable quality and unmatched designs** offered in Furniture. Apart from these, the
**resistance from termite, wear & tear and dust **along with their **longer service life** are other
attributes that attract clientele and retain them with us. We provide value to our clients for their
investments and ensure complete satisfaction with timely deliveries, reasonable pricing and ethical
& transparent dealings.

**Milestones
**
We present the entire growth of our company below:
* **1994** - Establishment of first store at Chandanagar across 200 sq ft
* **2000** - Upgrading Chandanagar store to 20,000 sq ft
* **2010** - Further expansion of Chandanagar store to 50,000 sq ft
* **2011** - Inauguration of new store at Miyapur in 10000 sq ft
* **2012** - Inauguration of Habsiguda branch in 70,000 sq ft
* **2013** - Inauguration of LB Nagar branch in 30,000 sq ft
**
Quality Assurance
**
Our concern towards the aspect of quality is very high and we make sure that no flaws are made on
our side during production. The Hostel Study Table, Digital Safe Locker, etc., we provide our
customers are excellently designed under the supervision of skilled and knowledgeable designers
following international trends. Moreover, the raw material we make use of during the production
process of our products are responsibly procured from authorized source. Before dispatch, we
properly inspect all our products to ensure their match with international trends, global quality
standards and industry norms.

**Our Infrastructure
**
At our end, we have developed an ultramodern infrastructure, which includes all the latest facility
for designing and developing the offered range. The instruments, tools and machines for developing
our SS Hospital Baby Trolley, Electric Fowler Bed, etc., are all advanced. These amenities enable us
to come up with an excellent array of furniture. Moreover, we have made optimum arrangements for
inspecting our well-designed and manufactured products to ensure their perfection. After the quality
testing process, we transfer the perfectly finished products to our sound warehousing section for
their categorical storage.

# **Welcome to the AWF Website**

**AWF** began its partnership in both the retail and RTO Industries serving the East and Central
Midwest in 1986 from Indianapolis, IN.

We began with the simple business model of stocking deep the 20% of home furnishings that produces
80% of the business, with delivery to our dealers on the **same day every week with company trucks
and drivers.**

This simple model has seen continuous growth over the past 30+ years. We now have thousands of
valued partners in both industries and we deliver between 600-800 stores every week!

This website is another effort to be a good partner with our current valued and prospective
customers. Take a few minutes to look over the site and you will find photos of all of our product
and some helpful training videos.

Please send your orders and questions via Phone, E-Mail, or Fax and our customer service will
respond to you immediately.

# **Welcome to the AWF Website**

**AWF** began its partnership in both the retail and RTO Industries serving the East and Central
Midwest in 1986 from Indianapolis, IN.

We began with the simple business model of stocking deep the 20% of home furnishings that produces
80% of the business, with delivery to our dealers on the **same day every week with company trucks
and drivers.**

This simple model has seen continuous growth over the past 30+ years. We now have thousands of
valued partners in both industries and we deliver between 600-800 stores every week!

This website is another effort to be a good partner with our current valued and prospective
customers. Take a few minutes to look over the site and you will find photos of all of our product
and some helpful training videos.

Please send your orders and questions via Phone, E-Mail, or Fax and our customer service will
respond to you immediately.

Where it all began - Penticton, 1945.

Bill and Nora Guerard opened our first showroom on Main Street with a simnple belief; that quality,
craftsmanship and genuine service would always stand the test of time. That philosophy still guides
us today.

Growing With Penticton - 1960's

A move to Front Street brought a larger showroom, and more inspired displays. Though the space grew,
the vision stayed the same; treating every customer like a neighbour and every piece like it
mattered,

A second generation takes the reigns

By the 1990's Doug Guerard was carrying forward the vision his parents began nearly 50 years
earlier. The showroom grew, styles changed, but the family's promise of craftsmanship and care never
wavered.

## Công cụ tính thuế nhập khẩu hàng hóa

Áp dụng cho Việt Nam. Người dùng nhập **Trị giá tính thuế** đã quy đổi. Công cụ hỗ trợ Thuế NK, VAT
và các thuế khác (TTĐB, chống bán phá giá, tự vệ, BVMT theo số lượng, và % khác). Kết quả làm tròn
đến **đồng**.

Mô tả hàng
Trị giá tính thuế *
Thuế NK %
VAT %
Chống bán phá giá %

Tự vệ %

TTĐB %

Khác %
BVMT: Số lượng hàng bị tính thuế
BVMT: Thuế BVMT/đv (VND)

Thêm dòng Xóa dòng Tính Xóa kết quả
**Công thức:**

    Thuế nhập khẩu phải nộp = Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu x Thuế suất thuế nhập khẩu
    
Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu = Tiền hàng + cước vận chuyển quốc tế theo điều kiện giao hàng + các kho
ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.
    
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt = Trị giá tính thuế thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt x Thuế suất = (Trị giá tính thuế n
k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

## The Lane Furniture Company Legacy

Since 1912, Lane Furniture has been synonymous with American craftsmanship, quality, and exceptional
comfort. Founded by John Lane in Altavista, Virginia, the company began as the Standard Red Cedar
Chest Company with a simple mission: to create furniture that families could cherish for
generations. Those iconic Lane cedar hope chests remain treasured heirlooms in homes across America
today.

Over the past century, Lane has evolved from cedar chests to become one of America’s most trusted
furniture brands, particularly renowned for revolutionary recliner designs and comfortable motion
furniture. In 1972, Lane acquired Action Industries, marking the beginning of the Lane Home
Furnishings recliner legacy. Today, Lane recliners—including wingback recliners, power recliners,
rocker recliners, and big man recliners—represent the pinnacle of American comfort furniture.

The Lane Furniture company’s Altavista, Virginia facility continues to produce furniture using
time-honored techniques combined with modern innovation. From Lane leather sofas and sectionals to
bedroom collections and accent furniture, each piece meets the exacting standards that have defined
the Lane Furniture brand for over 100 years. When you choose Lane, you’re investing in a legacy of
American quality and craftsmanship that becomes part of your home’s story.

## [ Lazyboy Power or Manual Recliner? Full Comparison ][13]

**Topics:** [Lazyboy Recliners Review][14] | [No Comments »][15]

Choosing between a Lazyboy power recliner and a manual recliner is one of the biggest decisions you
will make before buying a new chair. At first glance, both options may look similar. They can share
the same general shape, plush cushioning, supportive back, and relaxing reclined position. But the
way they function in everyday use can feel very different.

For some people, a manual recliner is the perfect choice because it is simple, reliable, and often
more affordable. For others, a power recliner is worth the extra cost because it offers easier
adjustment, better precision, and added convenience. The best option depends on your budget, body
needs, comfort preferences, room setup, and how you actually use your recliner every day.

This guide breaks down the full comparison between Lazyboy power and manual recliners so you can
decide which one is better for your home. We will cover comfort, ease of use, durability, repairs,
price, features, room planning, maintenance, and who each type is best for.

## What Is a Manual Lazyboy Recliner?

A manual Lazyboy recliner is operated by body pressure, a side handle, or a pull lever depending on
the model. To recline, you usually pull the handle or release mechanism and lean back using your own
body weight. To close the footrest, you generally push it back down with your legs and body
movement.

Manual recliners are popular because they are straightforward and do not require electricity. They
are often chosen by buyers who want a classic recliner feel with fewer electronic components.

If you are new to the category, it may help to also read about the broader [benefits of Lazyboy
recliner][16] ownership before narrowing down the power versus manual decision.

## What Is a Power Lazyboy Recliner?

A power Lazyboy recliner uses an electric motor to move the chair into different positions. Instead
of pushing back manually, you use built-in buttons or controls to raise the footrest, recline the
back, and sometimes adjust the headrest or lumbar support depending on the model.

Power recliners are designed for ease, convenience, and more precise positioning. Many users like
them because they can stop the recliner at many different angles instead of being limited to a more
basic manual range.

Some power recliners also include added features such as USB charging, power headrests, power lumbar
adjustment, or lift assistance on certain mobility-focused models.

## Comfort Comparison

### Power recliner comfort advantages

A power recliner usually gives you more control over your comfort because you can stop the chair at
many points instead of being limited to a few basic positions. This can make a big difference if you
like fine adjustments while reading, watching TV, or resting. Some people do not want to be fully
upright or fully reclined. A power recliner gives more in-between positions.

Higher-end models may also include power headrests and power lumbar support, which can improve neck
and lower-back comfort significantly.

### Manual recliner comfort advantages

A manual recliner can still be extremely comfortable. In fact, many people love the simpler, more
natural reclining motion of a manual chair. If the chair fits your body well, comfort can be
excellent even without power features.

Manual recliners also appeal to people who prefer a traditional recliner feel and do not care about
tiny position adjustments.

### Which is more comfortable overall?

If your idea of comfort includes customizable positioning, power usually wins. If your idea of
comfort is more about cushions, seat fit, and simple relaxation, a manual recliner may feel just as
good.

## Ease of Use Comparison

This is one of the biggest differences between the two.

A power recliner is much easier to use for people with arthritis, joint pain, back issues, reduced
strength, or mobility limitations. With the press of a button, the footrest rises and the chair
reclines gradually. You do not need to yank a handle or push back with your body.

A manual recliner requires more effort. Some are smooth and easy to use, but others may feel stiff
depending on the model, the user’s size, and the chair’s condition. For healthy users, that may not
be a problem. For older adults or anyone with limited strength, it can matter a lot.

## Recliner Medic

#### About Us

  

Is your recliner not working as smoothly as it once did? Having trouble getting up from a sunken
seat? Do you have a broken spring or mechanism that needs to be replaced? Or has your recliner just
stopped working completely? 



If the answer is yes to any of the questions above, your search for a solution ends here. 



Based in Markham, ON, Recliner Medic provides on site repair services for manual and electric
recliners and would be happy to bring life back to your favourite seat in the house! Why buy new
when it can be repaired as good as new for a fraction of the cost?



With over 30 years of experience in the upholstery industry, 20 years of experience as a certified
repair technician for a major Canadian furniture company, and 15 years of experience specializing in
recliner repair services, you can be confident in our ability to diagnose and repair your issue in
the quickest and most affordable way possible.



#### Our Services

We offer a wide range of services to meet your recliner repair needs. We use only the highest
quality materials and techniques to ensure your furniture looks its best and lasts for years to
come. 



**Recliner Repair services include but aren't limited to: **

 
* On-site repair & troubleshooting
*  Electrical component repair (Switches, electric motors, cables) 
* Repair or replacement of damaged mechanisms, springs, and seat and back padding
* Tightening and reinforcement of back of recliner
* Foot Extension repair





#### We Have the Tools to Get it Done

Major components and mechanisms are in stock now.

# SOISU — Italian luxury furniture, *engineered for the Indian home.*

SOISU is an Italian luxury furniture brand in India, applying Italian design discipline to furniture
assembled here. If you are searching for a luxury sofa in Mumbai — a leather sofa, a fabric sofa, a
bouclé or velvet one — this is the range: sofas, power recliners, beds, dining and armchairs,
specified for 40 °C and 85% humidity, and delivered in about 21 days under Standard Bespoke.

## Key takeaways
* • Italian design discipline, assembled in India — not imported, and never claimed to be.
* • Full-grain water-dyed Italian leather from Friuli; high-density European foam; kiln-dried
  hardwood frames.
* • Engineered and tested for Indian conditions: 40 °C and 85% relative humidity.
* • Standard Bespoke — custom size, material and finish, delivered in about 21 days.
* • Experience Centre: 4th Floor, Orbit Plaza, Prabhadevi, Mumbai. Pan-India delivery and
  installation.
* • Sofas ₹1.5L–₹12L · Recliners ₹3L–₹15L · Beds ₹2L–₹25L · Dining ₹1.5L–₹8L · Armchairs ₹1.5L–₹6L.

**About Us**

With a foresighted vision to carve your dream Furniture into reality as per latest trends, we, **Sri
Anu Furnitures And Furnishing**, established ourselves back in **1994**. Since then, we have been an
accredited** manufacturer and wholesaler** of **Mirrored Dressing Table, Modern Dressing Table,
Restaurant Luxury Banquet Chair, Auditorium Chair, Solid Wood Canteen Dining Table, Pneumatic
Revolving Stool, Classroom Furniture and more**. All these are designed and carved to perfection by
our team of skilled and highly proficient craftsmen, designers, carpenters and other personnel. We
also have a widespread infrastructural facility at **Hyderabad (India)** and showrooms across 4
cities like **Chandanagar, Miyapur, Habsiguda and LB Nagar**. These cover an overall area of** 1
lakh 60 thousand sq. ft**.

Having gained a reputed hold in the industry with immense goodwill amongst the clients has been a
result of **impeccable quality and unmatched designs** offered in Furniture. Apart from these, the
**resistance from termite, wear & tear and dust **along with their **longer service life** are other
attributes that attract clientele and retain them with us. We provide value to our clients for their
investments and ensure complete satisfaction with timely deliveries, reasonable pricing and ethical
& transparent dealings.

**Milestones
**
We present the entire growth of our company below:
* **1994** - Establishment of first store at Chandanagar across 200 sq ft
* **2000** - Upgrading Chandanagar store to 20,000 sq ft
* **2010** - Further expansion of Chandanagar store to 50,000 sq ft
* **2011** - Inauguration of new store at Miyapur in 10000 sq ft
* **2012** - Inauguration of Habsiguda branch in 70,000 sq ft
* **2013** - Inauguration of LB Nagar branch in 30,000 sq ft
**
Quality Assurance
**
Our concern towards the aspect of quality is very high and we make sure that no flaws are made on
our side during production. The Hostel Study Table, Digital Safe Locker, etc., we provide our
customers are excellently designed under the supervision of skilled and knowledgeable designers
following international trends. Moreover, the raw material we make use of during the production
process of our products are responsibly procured from authorized source. Before dispatch, we
properly inspect all our products to ensure their match with international trends, global quality
standards and industry norms.

**Our Infrastructure
**
At our end, we have developed an ultramodern infrastructure, which includes all the latest facility
for designing and developing the offered range. The instruments, tools and machines for developing
our SS Hospital Baby Trolley, Electric Fowler Bed, etc., are all advanced. These amenities enable us
to come up with an excellent array of furniture. Moreover, we have made optimum arrangements for
inspecting our well-designed and manufactured products to ensure their perfection. After the quality
testing process, we transfer the perfectly finished products to our sound warehousing section for
their categorical storage.

valued partners in both industries and we deliver between 600-800 stores every week!

Midwest in 1986 from Indianapolis, IN.

We began with the simple business model of stocking deep the 20% of home furnishings that produces
80% of the business, with delivery to our dealers on the **same day every week with company trucks
and drivers.**

## Công cụ tính thuế nhập khẩu hàng hóa

Áp dụng cho Việt Nam. Người dùng nhập **Trị giá tính thuế** đã quy đổi. Công cụ hỗ trợ Thuế NK, VAT
và các thuế khác (TTĐB, chống bán phá giá, tự vệ, BVMT theo số lượng, và % khác). Kết quả làm tròn
đến **đồng**.

Mô tả hàng
Trị giá tính thuế *
Thuế NK %
VAT %
Chống bán phá giá %

Tự vệ %

TTĐB %

Khác %
BVMT: Số lượng hàng bị tính thuế
BVMT: Thuế BVMT/đv (VND)

Thêm dòng Xóa dòng Tính Xóa kết quả
**Công thức:**

    Thuế nhập khẩu phải nộp = Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu x Thuế suất thuế nhập khẩu
    
Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu = Tiền hàng + cước vận chuyển quốc tế theo điều kiện giao hàng + các kho
ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.
    
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt = Trị giá tính thuế thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt x Thuế suất = (Trị giá tính thuế n
k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

## Công cụ tính thuế nhập khẩu hàng hóa

Áp dụng cho Việt Nam. Người dùng nhập **Trị giá tính thuế** đã quy đổi. Công cụ hỗ trợ Thuế NK, VAT
và các thuế khác (TTĐB, chống bán phá giá, tự vệ, BVMT theo số lượng, và % khác). Kết quả làm tròn
đến **đồng**.

Mô tả hàng
Trị giá tính thuế *
Thuế NK %
VAT %
Chống bán phá giá %

Tự vệ %

TTĐB %

Khác %
BVMT: Số lượng hàng bị tính thuế
BVMT: Thuế BVMT/đv (VND)

Thêm dòng Xóa dòng Tính Xóa kết quả
**Công thức:**

    Thuế nhập khẩu phải nộp = Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu x Thuế suất thuế nhập khẩu
    
Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu = Tiền hàng + cước vận chuyển quốc tế theo điều kiện giao hàng + các kho
ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.
    
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt = Trị giá tính thuế thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt x Thuế suất = (Trị giá tính thuế n
k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

## [ Lazyboy Power or Manual Recliner? Full Comparison ][13]

**Topics:** [Lazyboy Recliners Review][14] | [No Comments »][15]

Choosing between a Lazyboy power recliner and a manual recliner is one of the biggest decisions you
will make before buying a new chair. At first glance, both options may look similar. They can share
the same general shape, plush cushioning, supportive back, and relaxing reclined position. But the
way they function in everyday use can feel very different.

For some people, a manual recliner is the perfect choice because it is simple, reliable, and often
more affordable. For others, a power recliner is worth the extra cost because it offers easier
adjustment, better precision, and added convenience. The best option depends on your budget, body
needs, comfort preferences, room setup, and how you actually use your recliner every day.

This guide breaks down the full comparison between Lazyboy power and manual recliners so you can
decide which one is better for your home. We will cover comfort, ease of use, durability, repairs,
price, features, room planning, maintenance, and who each type is best for.

## What Is a Manual Lazyboy Recliner?

A manual Lazyboy recliner is operated by body pressure, a side handle, or a pull lever depending on
the model. To recline, you usually pull the handle or release mechanism and lean back using your own
body weight. To close the footrest, you generally push it back down with your legs and body
movement.

Manual recliners are popular because they are straightforward and do not require electricity. They
are often chosen by buyers who want a classic recliner feel with fewer electronic components.

If you are new to the category, it may help to also read about the broader [benefits of Lazyboy
recliner][16] ownership before narrowing down the power versus manual decision.

## What Is a Power Lazyboy Recliner?

A power Lazyboy recliner uses an electric motor to move the chair into different positions. Instead
of pushing back manually, you use built-in buttons or controls to raise the footrest, recline the
back, and sometimes adjust the headrest or lumbar support depending on the model.

Power recliners are designed for ease, convenience, and more precise positioning. Many users like
them because they can stop the recliner at many different angles instead of being limited to a more
basic manual range.

Some power recliners also include added features such as USB charging, power headrests, power lumbar
adjustment, or lift assistance on certain mobility-focused models.

## Comfort Comparison

### Power recliner comfort advantages

A power recliner usually gives you more control over your comfort because you can stop the chair at
many points instead of being limited to a few basic positions. This can make a big difference if you
like fine adjustments while reading, watching TV, or resting. Some people do not want to be fully
upright or fully reclined. A power recliner gives more in-between positions.

Higher-end models may also include power headrests and power lumbar support, which can improve neck
and lower-back comfort significantly.

### Manual recliner comfort advantages

A manual recliner can still be extremely comfortable. In fact, many people love the simpler, more
natural reclining motion of a manual chair. If the chair fits your body well, comfort can be
excellent even without power features.

Manual recliners also appeal to people who prefer a traditional recliner feel and do not care about
tiny position adjustments.

### Which is more comfortable overall?

If your idea of comfort includes customizable positioning, power usually wins. If your idea of
comfort is more about cushions, seat fit, and simple relaxation, a manual recliner may feel just as
good.

## Ease of Use Comparison

This is one of the biggest differences between the two.

A power recliner is much easier to use for people with arthritis, joint pain, back issues, reduced
strength, or mobility limitations. With the press of a button, the footrest rises and the chair
reclines gradually. You do not need to yank a handle or push back with your body.

A manual recliner requires more effort. Some are smooth and easy to use, but others may feel stiff
depending on the model, the user’s size, and the chair’s condition. For healthy users, that may not
be a problem. For older adults or anyone with limited strength, it can matter a lot.

## Recliner Medic

#### About Us

  

Is your recliner not working as smoothly as it once did? Having trouble getting up from a sunken
seat? Do you have a broken spring or mechanism that needs to be replaced? Or has your recliner just
stopped working completely? 



If the answer is yes to any of the questions above, your search for a solution ends here. 



Based in Markham, ON, Recliner Medic provides on site repair services for manual and electric
recliners and would be happy to bring life back to your favourite seat in the house! Why buy new
when it can be repaired as good as new for a fraction of the cost?



With over 30 years of experience in the upholstery industry, 20 years of experience as a certified
repair technician for a major Canadian furniture company, and 15 years of experience specializing in
recliner repair services, you can be confident in our ability to diagnose and repair your issue in
the quickest and most affordable way possible.



#### Our Services

We offer a wide range of services to meet your recliner repair needs. We use only the highest
quality materials and techniques to ensure your furniture looks its best and lasts for years to
come. 



**Recliner Repair services include but aren't limited to: **

 
* On-site repair & troubleshooting
*  Electrical component repair (Switches, electric motors, cables) 
* Repair or replacement of damaged mechanisms, springs, and seat and back padding
* Tightening and reinforcement of back of recliner
* Foot Extension repair





#### We Have the Tools to Get it Done

Major components and mechanisms are in stock now.

Why Standard Bespoke is right for India

## Four pillars. Every piece.

01 · Italian Design Authority

### Italian Craftsmanship

Italian design is the global benchmark for proportion, material quality and aesthetic precision.
SOISU's design process is rooted in this tradition — the same discipline that produced the world's
most admired interiors.

02 · Engineered for Indian Conditions

### Indian Engineering

Humidity above 60% causes untreated leather to crack and wood to warp. Every SOISU material is
selected and treated for Indian humidity cycles, 42°C summers and monsoon conditions — your
investment lasts decades, not seasons.

03 · Precision Over Customisation

### Standard Bespoke

Customisation introduces quality risk. SOISU's Standard Bespoke approach means every piece has been
designed once, with obsessive precision, tested across Indian conditions and refined before it
reaches your home. No guesswork.

04 · Lifetime Commitment

### 1-Year Warranty + Lifetime Service

Every SOISU piece carries a 1-year structural warranty, plus SOISU's commitment to support its
products at cost even beyond the warranty period. A SOISU sofa is a 15–25 year investment.

# SOISU — Italian luxury furniture, *engineered for the Indian home.*

SOISU is an Italian luxury furniture brand in India, applying Italian design discipline to furniture
assembled here. If you are searching for a luxury sofa in Mumbai — a leather sofa, a fabric sofa, a
bouclé or velvet one — this is the range: sofas, power recliners, beds, dining and armchairs,
specified for 40 °C and 85% humidity, and delivered in about 21 days under Standard Bespoke.

## Key takeaways
* • Italian design discipline, assembled in India — not imported, and never claimed to be.
* • Full-grain water-dyed Italian leather from Friuli; high-density European foam; kiln-dried
  hardwood frames.
* • Engineered and tested for Indian conditions: 40 °C and 85% relative humidity.
* • Standard Bespoke — custom size, material and finish, delivered in about 21 days.
* • Experience Centre: 4th Floor, Orbit Plaza, Prabhadevi, Mumbai. Pan-India delivery and
  installation.
* • Sofas ₹1.5L–₹12L · Recliners ₹3L–₹15L · Beds ₹2L–₹25L · Dining ₹1.5L–₹8L · Armchairs ₹1.5L–₹6L.
